##### Project general facts

Radiant Legacy is a commercial tower with 36 floors of office space, designed as a dedicated address for business. The project offers 158 office suites in small, medium and large formats, suitable for everything from independent practices to established and growing companies. Each suite is planned to make the most of natural light and views, while the tower's flowing, wave-shaped facade gives the building a distinctive presence on the skyline.

Tenants and their teams have access to a range of amenities designed around the rhythm of the working day. These include a swimming pool overlooking the city, a fully equipped gym within the wellness club, a padel court and a dedicated walking track for breaks between meetings. The building also provides 777 parking spaces for tenants, staff and visitors.

The interiors feature high-quality finishes, generous glazing and spacious layouts that support both focused work and collaboration. A double-height lobby with natural stone finishes, wood detailing and a reception area with secure access gates creates a professional first impression for clients and partners.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Shams Realm on Al Reem Island, one of Abu Dhabi's most connected and fast-growing districts. The area is a thriving mixed-use community that combines residential, retail, hospitality and green open spaces, placing businesses close to the people, partners and services they need.

Reem Central Park is about 3 minutes away, while Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi and Repton School can be reached in around 5 minutes. Galleria Mall, Reem Mall and Downtown Abu Dhabi are approximately 10 minutes away, and Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi and Abu Dhabi Mall are also nearby.

The district offers convenient access to beaches, parks and mangroves, including Shams Beach, Al Fay Park and the Mangrove Forest. Saadiyat Island is about 16 minutes away and Zayed International Airport around 25 minutes, making the location practical for both daily commuting and business travel.
